defect: NewColumnFamilyInfo stores a raw new ConstantColumnFamilyInfo via cf_info_map_[cf_key] = new ..., so when the same column family is registered twice (CreateColumnFamily during DB::Open with create_missing_column_families, then the loop over all handles at the end of DB::Open) the first object is leaked.
reason: Both the overwriting raw-pointer insert and the double registration in db_impl.cc come from this commit; the fix makes the map hold unique_ptr and removes the duplicate registration.

defect: The fix makes the new UnSchedule unit test poll for the scheduled task and take the task mutex before the stack-allocated SleepingBackgroundTask objects are destroyed, silencing a TSAN report.
reason: The repaired race lives only in unit-test code and the fix only changes the test, so it is a test change rather than a product defect.

defect: The fix rewrites the setup and expected counts of the newly added NonBottommostCompactionDropRangetombstone test, which was failing.
reason: Only the test's own setup and expectations change and the feature code is untouched, so this is a test change.

defect: The new empty default constructor SstFileMetaData() leaves the inherited FileStorageInfo fields at their base defaults (file_type kTempFile, empty relative_filename and directory), so GetLiveFilesMetaData reports wrong FileStorageInfo fields.
reason: The inheritance and the empty default constructor were added here while only the explicit constructor sets file_type to kTableFile; the fix sets it in the default constructor and fills the other fields in GetLiveFilesMetaData.

defect: ReadTableProperties now calls table_properties_.reset(table_properties) even when rocksdb::ReadTableProperties failed, taking ownership of an uninitialized pointer, which segfaults sst_dump on old-format files without a properties block.
reason: The old code returned before taking ownership on failure; this change moved the reset before the status check, and the fix initializes the pointer to nullptr and resets only on success.

defect: num_input_records and num_dropped_records are declared as int although they accumulate record counts over all compactions of a level, so they overflow.
reason: The fields were added as int by this change next to uint64_t byte counters; the fix widens them to uint64_t and also corrects the drop computation this change added in db_impl.cc.

defect: AddKey builds Slice prev pointing into entries_ and then calls entries_.append(), which may reallocate, so SamePrefix later reads freed memory (heap use-after-free).
reason: The prev slice and the append order were introduced by this change; the fix computes prev only after the append.

defect: The new coroutine MultiGetAsync/ProcessBatch path shares single num_filter_read/num_index_read/num_sst_read counters across levels and records the per-level histograms before the queued coroutines have run, so the per-level MultiGet statistics are wrong.
reason: MultiGetAsync and ProcessBatch with these scalar counters were added by this commit; the fix replaces them with a per-level stats map, and the wrong recording itself is in version_set.cc.

defect: The return value of ParseFileName is ignored while type and number are uninitialized, so for names it cannot parse (such as . and ..) the code switches on an uninitialized or stale FileType.
reason: The file is new in this change; the fix initializes the variables and skips names ParseFileName rejects, as valgrind reported.

defect: The added check returns NotSupported whenever db->GetRootDB() != db, so GetFromBatchAndDB stops working for every StackableDB wrapper.
reason: The rejection was added by this change and the fix removes it, casting db->GetRootDB() instead; the older raw cast was a separate pre-existing problem.

defect: The --verify_checksum flag is matched with strncmp over the flag length, so arguments with trailing characters (for example --verify_checksum=false or --verify_checksumXYZ) are silently accepted as enabling verification.
reason: The prefix comparison for this flag was added here, and the fix replaces it with an exact strcmp.

defect: The modified assert in LogAndApply lacks its terminating semicolon, so version_set.cc does not compile.
reason: The broken line was written by this change and the fix only adds the semicolon.

defect: xfunc.h forward-declares Options as class while it is defined as a struct, which clang rejects under -Werror,-Wmismatched-tags.
reason: The forward declaration is new in this change and breaks the clang debug build; knowing that Options is a struct requires options.h.

defect: pid_t pid = syscall(SYS_gettid) implicitly narrows the long result of syscall to pid_t, which fails the clang build under -Werror (-Wshorten-64-to-32).
reason: Both narrowing assignments are in the new file added by this change and the fix makes the conversions explicit to restore the clang build.

defect: After renaming the constructor parameter to _shared, the initializer rand(1000 + index + shared->GetSeed()) dereferences the not yet initialized member shared, so db_stress crashes with SIGSEGV.
reason: The rename was done by this -Wshadow cleanup and the fix changes shared to _shared in that initializer.

defect: The private fields max_grandparent_overlap_factor_ and expanded_compaction_factor_ are added but never used, which breaks the Mac clang build under -Werror,-Wunused-private-field.
reason: The fields were added by this change and the fix deletes them; seeing that they are unused requires compaction_picker.cc.

defect: The new LRUCacheShard::Ref returns false and does not increment the refcount for a handle that is no longer in the cache but still externally referenced (for example after its key was overwritten).
reason: Ref() is new in this change and the fix makes it increment refs in that case; the handle states it must support are documented in lru_cache.h.

defect: The new fprintf prints the int64_t entries_per_batch_ with %ld, a format mismatch on OS X where int64_t is long long, which breaks the -Werror build.
reason: The line was added in this change and the fix switches the format to PRIi64.

defect: toJavaStatusCode and toJavaStatusSubCode return the constants 0xFF and 0xFE as jbyte (signed char), a truncating constant conversion that MSVC rejects.
reason: Both functions are new in this change and the fix changes the constants to 0x7F and 0x7E so MSVC compiles.

defect: The new EstimatedActiveKeys test passes uint64_t expressions to the int level and uint32_t file_number parameters of Add, which clang rejects under -Werror, so the test file does not compile.
reason: The failing calls were added in this change and the fix switches the constants to uint32_t with a cast; it is a build break even though the file is a test.

defect: The fix stops leaking the SpecialEnv allocated with new in the ReadAhead unit test by using the fixture's env_ instead.
reason: The leak and its fix are confined to unit-test code (found by valgrind), so the fix is a test change.

defect: sscanf with %lu into a uint64_t breaks the build where uint64_t is unsigned long long (clang -Wformat under -Werror).
reason: The format string and the uint64_t variable were introduced here and the fix uses PRIu64.

defect: Both overloaded native multiGet methods are defined under the short JNI name Java_org_rocksdb_RocksDB_multiGet instead of the mangled names JNI requires for overloaded natives, so the JVM cannot link them.
reason: Both functions were added by this change and the fix renames them to the overload-mangled JNI names.

defect: old_saved_seqno is declared without an initializer and assigned only under s.ok(), which GCC flags as maybe-uninitialized and the -Werror ASAN build rejects.
reason: SaveAtAndAfter is new in this change and the fix initializes the variable to restore the build.

defect: The private member key_length_ is initialized but never used, which fails the clang build under -Werror,-Wunused-private-field.
reason: The field came with the new cuckoo table builder in this change and the fix removes it; its private declaration is in cuckoo_table_builder.h.

defect: The fix makes the mempurge and SST counters of the MemPurge unit tests atomic to silence a TSAN data-race report between the flush thread's sync-point callbacks and the test thread.
reason: The race is in test-only counters (the same pattern already existed in the older MemPurge tests) and the fix only touches the test file, so it is a test change.

defect: CreateColumnFamily returns InvalidArgument (column family already exists) when the name does not exist, inverting the check so that creating a new column family always fails.
reason: The negated condition was added by this change and the fix removes the negation.

defect: histogramData checks the histogram type against the ticker limits (INTERNAL_TICKER_ENUM_MAX, TICKER_ENUM_MAX) instead of the histogram limits, so out-of-range indexes into histograms_ are not caught.
reason: The copy-pasted assert was introduced here and the fix uses the histogram enum limits.

defect: The fix removes a flaky timing assertion that compared file_ingestion_blocking_live_writes_nanos with the write thread's wait time in the Basic unit test.
reason: Only a test assertion is removed; this is a test change, not a product defect.

defect: SaveValue calls timer.ElapsedNanos() on a StopWatchNano built from env_, which dereferences a null Env for callers that pass nullptr; the new env parameter also left cuckoo_table_reader_test.cc callers uncompilable.
reason: The env parameter and the unguarded ElapsedNanos calls were added by this change; seeing the null dereference needs StopWatchNano and the callers.

defect: UpdateResult takes a uint32_t alignment while Posix_IOHandle stores alignment as size_t, an implicit 64-to-32 conversion that clang rejects under -Werror.
reason: Both the size_t field and the uint32_t parameter are new in this change and the fix makes the parameter size_t.

defect: RocksLuaCompactionFilter::Name() returns c_str() of a local std::string, a dangling pointer (heap use-after-free under ASAN and valgrind).
reason: Name() was added with this new filter in rocks_lua_compaction_filter.cc, and the fix adds a mutable name_ member in the header to hold the string.

defect: GetUpdatesSince allocates probableWALFiles with raw new and returns early (no matching files, later also on error) without deleting it, leaking the vector.
reason: The raw allocation with an early-return path was introduced by this change; the fix wraps it in a unique_ptr.

defect: RecordLevelNSlowdown adds micros to stall_leveln_slowdown_count_ instead of incrementing it, so the per-level slowdown count is wrong.
reason: The previous db_impl.cc code incremented the count; this new file introduced += micros and the fix restores the increment.

defect: The assertion added in FilePickerMultiGet::ReplaceRange (curr_level_ == 0 || !RemainingOverlapInLevel()) does not hold in valid states, so debug builds can abort in MultiGet.
reason: The assert was introduced by this change and the fix replaces it with hit_file_ == nullptr; showing it is wrong needs the file-picker state logic outside the diff.

defect: data->max = max() implicitly converts the uint64_t maximum to the double field HistogramData::max, which the VS2015 build rejects.
reason: The assignment was added by this change and the fix adds an explicit conversion; the field type is declared in statistics.h.

defect: The fix makes FaultInjectionTestFS direct-writable during DB open even with write_fault_one_in, so WAL data written before the first sync is not lost when db_stress is killed.
reason: FaultInjectionTestFS was already non-direct-writable by default before this change, so for write_fault_one_in the WAL loss predates it.

defect: TestCompactionListener::OnCompactionCompleted uses a signature that does not match EventListener::OnCompactionCompleted(DB*, const CompactionJobInfo&), so it hides the virtual (clang -Werror build failure) and is never called.
reason: The test listener was added here with the wrong signature and the fix makes it override the real method; the base signature is in listener.h.

defect: VerifyChecksumInBlocks always reads through a FilePrefetchBuffer, which does not work with mmap reads and makes VerifyChecksum report false checksum failures in mmap mode.
reason: The readahead buffer was added by this change and the fix disables it when allow_mmap_reads is set; the incompatibility lies in the prefetch buffer and file reader code.

defect: The replacement condition in HexToString is inverted: it throws for input that starts with 0x and accepts input that does not.
reason: The boost::starts_with check was rewritten without its negation in this change and the fix negates the condition.
